content:
It might seem a little early for Black Friday sales to be kicking off in earnest, but that’s exactly what we’ve been seeing this week. Deeply discounted Black Friday deals are popping up in sporadic bursts at retailers across the internet. Anyone interested in saving money on LEGO sets in particular has a nice variety of options available right now. You can be sure more LEGO deals will come online in the days ahead as well, but for now, here are the best early Black Friday LEGO deals available.

LEGO Sets on Sale

If you’re looking for the best early Black Friday deals on LEGO sets right now, Amazon and Target are the places to shop. Both have a handful of sets on sale for up to 40% off, which is about the lowest you can ever expect to see LEGO sets drop, even during clearance sales.

I particularly love the Up-Scaled Darth Vader Minifigure set that's on sale at Target. It takes the now-iconic Darth Vader minifigure that’s appeared in countless LEGO Star Wars sets over the years, and blows it up into a full-sized set. For a Sith lord, it's oddly adorable. I also own the LEGO London set, which is a great deal at $23.99 ( Amazon ) and looks nice as a micro-scale display piece. And although they just came out a couple months ago, the LEGO Pokémon sets based on Pikachu and Arcanine are already on sale. They're both aimed at adults and intended for display.

LEGO Pokémon and Star Wars Smart Play Sets on Sale

A number of Smart Play LEGO sets are also on sale. These are in the LEGO Star Wars and LEGO Pokémon themes. However, none of the Smart Play sets on sale right now actually include a Smart Brick, which happens to be the key to the whole Smart Play thing. On their own, these sets won’t light up or make sounds. You need a set that comes with a Smart Brick to take full advantage of those sets.

Amazon’s Black Friday 2026 sale starts on Thursday, November 19. Because it hasn’t officially kicked off yet, I’m not entirely surprised to see just a few LEGO sets on sale. If you don’t see anything you want now, check back later as a deluge of deals is heading our way soon.
